title: 聊游戏爱好：从共同兴趣到一起玩
subtitle: 先听懂爱好闲聊，再用自然词块聊 FPS 游戏并发出邀请

audio.title: Talking about personal interests
audio.note: 页面含完整 transcript。视频总长 4:14.4；已实际打开并播放至 2:08.9，确认音画可播放。今天无字幕使用 0:16–1:25（约 69 秒）的办公室对话；先不要展开 Transcript。

sections.title: 1｜无字幕听力（4 分钟）
sections.body: 打开视频，先把字幕关掉，只听 0:16–1:25。第一遍只抓人物关系和主题，不要逐词翻译；第二遍记下你听到的 3 个关键词。完整原文在来源页的 Transcript 折叠栏，答题前先别打开。
questions: 两个人主要在聊什么：工作任务、周末爱好，还是旅行计划？
他们发现了什么共同点？Paul 大约多久做一次这件事？
sections.answers:
1. 他们在聊下班后的爱好。
2. 两个人都练习冥想；Paul 通常每周一到两次。

sections.title: 2｜精听、连读与跟读（4 分钟）
sections.body:
把 0:33–1:19 再听两遍，重点辨认：
1) “What do you do when you’re not working?” 中 what do you 常连成 /wɒdəjə/，you 和 are 都很轻。
2) “Haven’t you got any hobbies?” 中 haven’t you 常听起来像 /ˈhævəntʃə/，t + y 会靠近 /tʃ/。
3) “once or twice a week” 中 once_or 连读，a 弱读 /ə/。
练法：每句先只听一次 → 看上面提示模仿三次 → 关掉文字再听一次。最后跟着原声影子跟读 20–30 秒，声音比原声慢半拍。
questions: 你能在原声里听出 what do you 的三个词，还是更像一个整体？
把 once or twice a week 连续说三遍，a 要轻还是重？
sections.answers:
1. 自然语流中更像一个整体 /wɒdəjə/。
2. a 要弱读成 /ə/，不要逐词重读。

sections.title: 3｜原创阅读：A shared interest（4 分钟）
sections.body: Leo met Sam in an online English group. After class, Sam asked what Leo did in his free time. Leo said he was really into FPS games, especially Apex Legends. He usually played on his own because it helped him focus, but he sometimes joined friends at weekends. Sam played Apex too, so he asked Leo what he liked about it. Leo explained that he enjoyed making quick decisions and improving his aim. He also liked trying different weapons, although the Flatline was his favourite. Sam was surprised because he often used the same weapon. They compared their playing styles and laughed about their worst matches. Before leaving, Sam said, “Do you want to play together sometime?” Leo agreed, but he politely explained that he was free only on Sunday evening. They exchanged usernames and planned one short match. A simple question about hobbies had helped two new people find something in common.
questions: Why does Leo often play on his own?
What plan do Leo and Sam make at the end?
sections.translation: Leo 在一个线上英语小组认识了 Sam。下课后，Sam 问 Leo 空闲时间做什么。Leo 说他很喜欢第一人称射击游戏，尤其是《Apex 英雄》。他通常自己玩，因为这能帮助他集中注意力，但周末有时也会和朋友一起。Sam 也玩 Apex，于是问 Leo 喜欢它哪一点。Leo 解释说，他喜欢快速做决定，也喜欢提高瞄准水平。他还喜欢尝试不同的武器，不过 Flatline 是他的最爱。Sam 很惊讶，因为他也常用同一把武器。他们比较了各自的玩法，还拿自己最糟糕的对局开玩笑。离开前，Sam 问：“你想找时间一起玩吗？”Leo 同意了，但礼貌地说明自己只有周日晚上有空。他们交换了用户名，并约好打一局短局。一个简单的爱好问题，帮助两个新认识的人找到了共同点。
sections.answers:
1. Because playing alone helps him focus.
2. They exchange usernames and plan to play one short match on Sunday evening.

sections.title: 4｜词汇与高频词块（4 分钟）
sections.body:
1) in my free time｜在空闲时间｜In my free time, I usually play one or two matches.｜空闲时我通常打一两局。
2) be into ...｜很喜欢……｜I’m really into fast-paced games.｜我很喜欢快节奏游戏。
3) play on my own｜自己玩｜I often play on my own after work.｜下班后我经常自己玩。
4) play with friends｜和朋友一起玩｜I play with friends at weekends.｜我周末和朋友一起玩。
5) What do you like about it?｜你喜欢它哪一点？｜What do you like about Apex?｜你喜欢 Apex 哪一点？
6) find something in common｜找到共同点｜We quickly found something in common.｜我们很快找到了共同点。
7) Do you want to ... sometime?｜要不要找时间……？｜Do you want to play sometime?｜要不要找时间一起玩？
8) be free on ...｜在……有空｜I’m free on Sunday evening.｜我周日晚上有空。
9) fast-paced｜节奏快的｜It’s exciting because it’s fast-paced.｜它节奏快，所以很刺激。
10) exchange usernames｜交换用户名｜We exchanged usernames after class.｜我们下课后交换了用户名。
sections.answers: 今天优先整块记 1–8，不要先拆成单词逐个翻译。复述时至少用：be into、What do you like about it?、Do you want to ... sometime?

sections.title: 5｜语法：like / enjoy + -ing（3 分钟）
sections.body:
谈爱好时，like / love / enjoy 后面常接动词 -ing。enjoy 后通常不用 to do。
例句 1：I like playing FPS games after work.｜我喜欢下班后玩 FPS 游戏。
例句 2：I enjoy making quick decisions.｜我喜欢快速做决定。
questions: 改错：I enjoy to try different weapons.
sections.answers:
1. playing
2. I enjoy trying different weapons.

sections.title: 6｜双人对话、替换与快速回应（4 分钟）
sections.body:
原创对话：
A: What do you do in your free time?
B: I’m really into FPS games. I often play Apex on my own.
A: Nice! What do you like about it?
B: I enjoy making quick decisions and improving my aim.
A: I play Apex too. Do you want to play together sometime?
B: Sure. I’m free on Sunday evening. Is eight OK for you?
A: Perfect. Let’s exchange usernames.

替换练习：
1) FPS games / hiking / cooking / watching films
2) Sunday evening / Saturday afternoon / after work

快速回应（每题 3 秒内开口）：
1) A new friend asks, “What do you do in your free time?”
2) Someone likes the same game. Show interest and ask one follow-up question.
3) A friend invites you tonight, but you are free only on Sunday. Accept and change the time politely.

口头任务（30–60 秒）：说出你喜欢的一种游戏或爱好、你喜欢它的两个原因、你通常独自还是和朋友一起做，最后邀请对方找时间一起参加。尽量整块说，不要在脑中逐词翻译。
sections.answers:
参考快速回应：
1) I’m really into FPS games. I usually play Apex after work.
2) Me too! What do you like about it?
3) I’d love to, but I’m not free tonight. How about Sunday evening?

sections.title: 7｜昨日词块复习与反馈（1 分钟）
sections.body:
把昨天订餐场景的词块迁移到今天：
1) Is eight OK for you?｜八点可以吗？
2) Could I change it to Sunday?｜我可以改到周日吗？
3) No problem.｜没问题。

完成后回原聊天告诉我：① 无字幕听懂比例；② 最卡的一句；③ 用英文打字或语音回答“What do you do in your free time?”。只有收到并实际分析你的语音后，我才会评价发音。
sections.answers: 自检：你是否能不看中文，直接用 Is eight OK for you? 和 Could I change it to Sunday? 完成一次改时间？
